include_analysis.method: Parse direct quoted/angle includes at each foundation revision, resolve relative source paths, then Tarjan SCC. Header/source families fold identical basename stems; external includes recorded separately. Static include analysis is not linker or runtime proof.

coupling_notes.reason: PipeCore.cpp implements both Session and ScopedSourceImage. Folding implementation/header families produces the PipeCore/Session SCC; declarations alone have no include cycle. Keep private session state and implementation together.
SDK callback trampolines, admitted install and reverse runtime share ownership and callback lifetime; keep this semantic/link closure together. Not claimed as an include SCC.

Worker admission and paired file/EOS completion consume the same callback ownership chain; internal includes are directed rather than a forced SCC. This is a review-cohesion choice, not proof that finer subdivision is impossible.

assembly.strategy: Stack groups 1 through 7; materialize exact listed foundation blobs, tests, and component-only deltas. Broad original commits mix modules and must not be cherry-picked wholesale into an early group. Each new-file blob is reused byte-for-byte, with no stub or redesign.
assembly.backend_selection: No new game backend selection in groups 1-7. Preserve b41abddac/967076aae/0458501d2 and following game-selection changes for their existing package, then Bink packages and release-build deltas in original order.
assembly.completion: Replay per-file deferred component deltas in original ancestry order, preserving all recorded final blob IDs. This is a future assembly invariant; no assembly or test run was performed here.
assembly.build: Stage the unchanged pre-selection build.py and sources.json only in group 7, after all referenced sources/tests exist; do not invent truncated runners. The native facade and host/pipe outputs are separate targets; engine-worker uses real engine headers/settings.
assembly.ci: The original EOS protocol workflow hunk can accompany group 1 only on a base already carrying the existing wire workflow. Otherwise defer that exact hunk until the workflow prerequisite is present; source/test introduction is independent.

limits: Existing integrated evidence remains historical; split foundations have not been individually built or runtime-qualified.
No claim of callback fidelity, heap safety, shutdown acceptance or independently enabled functionality is added.
Private SDK and engine configuration requirements concern compiling the host/native/worker targets, not permission to introduce dormant foundation sources.
This addendum supersedes only the parent Miles-core grouping; later Miles game selection, Bink and release integration packages retain their scope.
